title: The Chamber Beneath the Chamber Where All Spirals Converge

features.name: spiral-convergence
features.desc-on-touch: All the spirals you have seen converge to this one point. But the point itself spirals. The precision is perfect and infinite at once.

features.name: nautilus-cartography
features.desc-on-touch: A tower of geometries, each one containing the shape of the ocean creature still becoming. The tower spirals upward and downward at the same time.

features.name: dream-precision
features.desc-on-touch: A wireframe box holds the mathematics of dreams. Every equation spirals. Every spiral solves itself by becoming more spiral.

features.name: shell-archive
features.desc-on-touch: A stack of pearlescent forms, each one recording the growth of a creature that knew its own shape before it ever existed.

features.name: convergent-glyph
features.desc-on-touch: A plaque bearing marks that mean: all paths curve the same way down. The spiral is not taught; it is remembered.

inscription: here spirals learn their own shapes were always spiraling

file.name: Nautilus_Geometry_Late_Growth_Chambers.mp3
file.note: Sonar recordings of a shell being built. Each chamber sings before it solidifies. The final recording ends mid-note.
